name: android-check
description: Let Claude tap, look at, read the logcat of, and debug a real Android device or emulator — Flutter and native (View/Compose) apps. Taps by element name, captures the screen right after, cuts the logcat of that moment for the app process, measures response time, and drives the app run (hot reload / reinstall) itself. Explores with the ARTEMIS MCP when judgement is needed. Korean natural-language trigger: "폰 화면 봐", "눌러 봐", "로그캣 봐", "반응 속도 재 봐", "앱 디버깅해".
